style:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete square equipable background scene for a cute creature-collecting game, in the same family as the approved Autumn Woods illustration.
ART STYLE: inviting hand-drawn 2D storybook/cartoon environment; confident smooth dark brown/plum contours; chunky rounded organic shapes; clean broad flat colors with simple cel-shaded shadows; soft atmospheric color separation in distant layers. Cohesive mobile-game art, not realistic, not painterly or textured. Environment scenery, not an inventory icon.
CANVAS: square 1536x1536 target for JPG export. Fully opaque, full bleed edge to edge, no border, tile frame, vignette or blank margins.
GAME COMPOSITION: eye-level view. A creature will be added separately at horizontal center, feet at y=93% of the image. Do not draw that creature. Keep x=28-72%, y=75-100% an unobstructed calm standing area on a broad biome-appropriate foreground surface. Foreground extends through the bottom edge, not a circular pedestal or isolated platform. Keep x=32-68%, y=50-90% lower contrast and relatively simple behind the body. Place major decorative rocks, roots, foliage or architecture toward the sides. Never place a hole, steep ledge, lava, tall plant or bright focal object at the foot point. For intentionally abstract space/void scenes, a quiet dark lower field is enough; don't invent a physical floor.
CROP SAFETY: center-bottom crop in game: wide stages lose the top, tall stages lose the sides. Carry recognizable scene colors and secondary theme cues into the lower half and middle distance. Preserve a coherent lower central composition when edges are cut.
FUTURE ANIMATION: use distinct broad silhouettes in foreground, middle distance and far background with simple clean boundaries. Stable ground plane; foliage, water, mist or cloud masses can be animated later. No baked motion blur, busy spray, streaks, drifting leaf confetti or fine particles. This is ONE static integrated image, not a sprite/layer sheet.
NO text, labels, logos, UI, watermark, featured characters, humans, detailed animals, photorealistic texture, excessive tiny leaves, noisy rock facets or glitter speckles. Environmental fauna only when explicitly required by the scene description. Let the scene-specific palette and geometry below determine the biome; do not add autumn trees or mushrooms to unrelated environments.

ART STYLE: inviting hand-drawn 2D storybook/cartoon environment; confident smooth dark brown/plum contours; chunky rounded organic shapes; clean broad flat colors with simple cel-shaded shadows; soft atmospheric color separation in distant layers. Cohesive mobile-game art, not realistic, not painterly or textured. Environment scenery, not an inventory icon.
CANVAS: square 1536x1536 target for JPG export. Fully opaque, full bleed edge to edge, no border, tile frame, vignette or blank margins.
GAME COMPOSITION: eye-level view. A creature will be added separately at horizontal center, feet at y=93% of the image. Do not draw that creature. Keep x=28-72%, y=75-100% an unobstructed calm standing area on a broad biome-appropriate foreground surface. Foreground extends through the bottom edge, not a circular pedestal or isolated platform. Keep x=32-68%, y=50-90% lower contrast and relatively simple behind the body. Place major decorative rocks, roots, foliage or architecture toward the sides. Never place a hole, steep ledge, lava, tall plant or bright focal object at the foot point. For intentionally abstract space/void scenes, a quiet dark lower field is enough; don't invent a physical floor.
CROP SAFETY: center-bottom crop in game: wide stages lose the top, tall stages lose the sides. Carry recognizable scene colors and secondary theme cues into the lower half and middle distance. Preserve a coherent lower central composition when edges are cut.
FUTURE ANIMATION: use distinct broad silhouettes in foreground, middle distance and far background with simple clean boundaries. Stable ground plane; foliage, water, mist or cloud masses can be animated later. No baked motion blur, busy spray, streaks, drifting leaf confetti or fine particles. This is ONE static integrated image, not a sprite/layer sheet.
NO text, labels, logos, UI, watermark, featured characters, humans, detailed animals, photorealistic texture, excessive tiny leaves, noisy rock facets or glitter speckles. Environmental fauna only when explicitly required by the scene description. Let the scene-specific palette and geometry below determine the biome; do not add autumn trees or mushrooms to unrelated environments.

Cohesive mobile-game art, not realistic, not painterly or textured. Environment scenery, not an inventory icon.
CANVAS: square 1536x1536 target for JPG export. Fully opaque, full bleed edge to edge, no border, tile frame, vignette or blank margins.
GAME COMPOSITION: eye-level view. A creature will be added separately at horizontal center, feet at y=93% of the image. Do not draw that creature. Keep x=28-72%, y=75-100% an unobstructed calm standing area on a broad biome-appropriate foreground surface. Foreground extends through the bottom edge, not a circular pedestal or isolated platform. Keep x=32-68%, y=50-90% lower contrast and relatively simple behind the body. Place major decorative rocks, roots, foliage or architecture toward the sides. Never place a hole, steep ledge, lava, tall plant or bright focal object at the foot point. For intentionally abstract space/void scenes, a quiet dark lower field is enough; don't invent a physical floor.
CROP SAFETY: center-bottom crop in game: wide stages lose the top, tall stages lose the sides. Carry recognizable scene colors and secondary theme cues into the lower half and middle distance. Preserve a coherent lower central composition when edges are cut.
FUTURE ANIMATION: use distinct broad silhouettes in foreground, middle distance and far background with simple clean boundaries. Stable ground plane; foliage, water, mist or cloud masses can be animated later. No baked motion blur, busy spray, streaks, drifting leaf confetti or fine particles. This is ONE static integrated image, not a sprite/layer sheet.
NO text, labels, logos, UI, watermark, featured characters, humans, detailed animals, photorealistic texture, excessive tiny leaves, noisy rock facets or glitter speckles. Environmental fauna only when explicitly required by the scene description. Let the scene-specific palette and geometry below determine the biome; do not add autumn trees or mushrooms to unrelated environments.
